summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of the sale of its rights, interests, and obligations in Western Australian exploration license E45/2364 (Tabba Tabba) to Wildcat Resources Limited (ASX: WC8). Total consideration is A$16 million: A$5 million cash on completion, A$8 million in Wildcat shares at A$0.353 per share, A$3 million deferred cash payable six months after a feasibility study announcement, and contingent payments of A$0.70 per tonne of JORC pegmatite resource. Elevra CEO Lucas Dow stated proceeds will fund North American growth initiatives. No advisors or board recommendation disclosed. Transaction simplifies portfolio; watch for feasibility study timing and exploration results affecting contingent payments.
